The plot illustrates the trends of exports and imports over time, with a secondary representation of a balance. The x-axis is labeled “Year” and spans from 2020 to 2023, with tick labels at yearly intervals. The y-axis on the left is labeled “Exporte (linke Skala)” and ranges from 0 to 400, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 50, and units of “Mrd. US-Dollar”. The y-axis on the right is labeled “Saldo (rechte Skala)” and ranges from -200 to 400, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 100, and units of “Mrd. US-Dollar”. 

The “Exporte (linke Skala)” line is colored purple and solid, starting at approximately 180 in 2020, decreasing to approximately 140 in early 2021, then generally increasing to approximately 240 by the end of 2023. The “Importe (linke Skala)” line is colored blue and solid, beginning at approximately 220 in 2020, decreasing to approximately 180 in early 2021, then fluctuating between approximately 220 and 360, and ending at approximately 370 in 2023. The “Saldo (rechte Skala)” is represented by a filled blue area, starting at approximately 100 in 2020, decreasing to approximately -40 in early 2021, and fluctuating between approximately -100 and 100, ending at approximately 30 in 2023.
